common.saved_needs_restart: Saved — used once «{{service}}» is restarted (Maintenance → Service restart).
common.vllm_rolled_back: New container did not start – previous container restored
common.hot_reload_hint: Run hot-reload in Maintenance for changes to take effect

location.title: Location
location.description: Used by Kåre for weather, time and geographic context. Never hardcoded — stored in configs/settings.yaml.

city.label: City
city.hint: Name of the place you live

language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the language for the admin GUI and what language Kåre responds in. Takes effect immediately.
language.gui_hint: Controls the language of this administration interface
language.kare_hint: Controls the language of Kåre's responses

network.title: Network and access
network.description: Which addresses count as home and VPN, which reverse proxies KTSB trusts, and whether the API documentation is open. Changes apply at once.
network.local_subnets_hint: Your home network, comma-separated (e.g. 192.168.0.0/24). Users from here count as at home.
network.trusted_proxies_hint: Only these may state the client's address (X-Forwarded-For). IP, subnet or host name, comma-separated. Default: caddy, 127.0.0.1, ::1. Add your own reverse proxy here.
network.api_docs_hint: Opens /docs, /redoc and /openapi.json. Off by default — the map of every endpoint is useful to an attacker.

logs.title: Logs and data
logs.description: How often logs are written to disk, and how long conversations and memories are kept.
logs.flush_hint: Log lines are collected in memory and written to disk together. Low values mean many small writes (more I/O, faster SD-card wear). High values mean more lines can be lost in a power cut. 0 = write every line at once. Recommended: 2–10.
logs.flush_warn_low: Many small disk writes — more I/O and faster wear on SD cards/eMMC.
logs.flush_warn_high: In a power cut or crash, up to {{seconds}} seconds of log lines can be lost.
logs.retention_hint: 0 = keep forever (the disk keeps growing). A number = older data is permanently deleted at night, and the assistant can no longer remember or look it up.
logs.retention_warn_low: Very short: everything older than {{days}} days is permanently deleted every night.
logs.think_reply_label: Reply length in the think log (characters)
logs.think_reply_hint: How much of each reply is kept next to the thinking ({{min}}–{{max}}, default {{def}}). The thinking is always kept whole. Used to measure the model guard on long replies; the reply is stored as plain text in the think log.

gateway.title: HA Gateway
gateway.description: Kåre's HA bridge (kaare_ha_gateway.py) — executes smart home commands. URL stored in configs/services.yaml.
gateway.timeout_hint: Max wait time per HA call
gateway.verify_hint: How long Kåre waits for HA to report the new state after an action (0–10). If the device answers sooner, it is immediate. Some Tuya and Zigbee lights report a moment after they change — then Kåre says «sent, not confirmed», not «failed».
gateway.enabled_hint: Off: Kåre controls no devices and reads no HA sensors. The setup wizard turns it on once URL and token are saved. A new URL or token takes effect immediately.

token.title: Home Assistant Token
token.description: Long-lived access token. Stored in configs/ha_token.env — not in code.
token.new_hint: Paste token from HA → Profile → Security → Long-lived tokens

advanced.title: HA Gateway — Advanced Settings
advanced.description: Timeout, log URL and security list of allowed HA actions. Stored in configs/kare_ha.env.
advanced.log_url_hint: Endpoint Kåre receives HA logs on
advanced.allowed_hint: Actions Kåre is allowed to perform against Home Assistant. Volume, source and pause apply to media players (speakers and TVs). New actions that come with an update are allowed until you untick them here.

card.title: MQTT
card.description: The connection to the MQTT broker. The topics Frigate and extra face recognition use are set in the Frigate tab. Stored in configs/services.yaml and configs/mqtt.env.
card.host_hint: IP or hostname of the MQTT broker (e.g. Home Assistant)
card.password_hint: Leave field empty to keep existing password.
card.tls_hint: Enable encrypted connection (port 8883). Requires broker to support TLS.
card.client_hint: Unique MQTT client ID. Leave empty for auto-generated ID.
card.reconnect_hint: Seconds to wait between reconnection attempts on disconnect.

vpn.title: WireGuard VPN
vpn.description: Endpoint that VPN clients connect to. Stored in configs/settings.yaml.
vpn.host_hint: Your DuckDNS domain (e.g. my-name.duckdns.org). Leave empty if VPN is not configured.

agentMessages.title: Internal communication
agentMessages.subtitle: Messages between agents
agentMessages.empty: No agent communication logged yet. Happens the first time Kåre asks an agent something.

llm.description: One section per LLM role. Stored in configs/llm.yaml. Restart the affected service after changes.
llm.ctx_warning: All calls to the same Ollama instance MUST use identical num_ctx — mismatch forces full model reload (~3.5 min).
llm.model_missing: The model «{{model}}» is not downloaded in Ollama — this role won't work until it is.
llm.model_unreachable: Can't reach {{url}} — unable to check whether the model is downloaded.
llm.whisper_lang_note: STT language follows the chat language (kare_language, set under General) — no separate switch here.
llm.whisper_lang_warning: The model "{{model}}" likely only supports {{supported}} — not "{{lang}}". STT accuracy may suffer.
llm.whisper_backend_hint: faster_whisper works on all platforms (CPU/GPU). openvino requires an Intel Arc GPU and OpenVINO GenAI — used with NbAiLab/nb-whisper-large.
llm.restart_needed_hint: A restart is required for changes to take effect.
llm.memembed_intro: 384-dim embedding for semantic memory search. Uses {{model}} (ONNX).
llm.memembed_files: The model must be stored locally — place these files in the folder below:
llm.memembed_autostart_hint: The service starts automatically once enabled and the model files are present in the folder.
llm.emb_info_box: ℹ️ {{model}} is converted to OpenVINO IR format and lives locally at {{path}}. Used by the NPU and CPU backends with no internet access.
llm.emb_backend_hint: torch loads the model automatically from HuggingFace and works on AMD/Intel/Apple Silicon. OpenVINO requires an already-converted IR model and an Intel NPU/iGPU.
llm.emb_hf_model_hint_ov: Model name (used as a reference for tokenizer loading). For OpenVINO, the IR model at the path below is used instead.
llm.emb_hf_model_hint_torch: Model name on HuggingFace. Downloaded automatically on first start.
llm.emb_current_dim_label: Vector dimension for the selected model:
llm.emb_dim_change_warning: You're switching from {{from}}-dim to {{to}}-dim. The Qdrant collections {{col1}} and {{col2}} must be deleted and rebuilt — this erases all stored memory.
llm.emb_local_path_hint: Path to an already-converted OpenVINO IR model. Contains openvino_model.xml and openvino_model.bin.
llm.piper_intro: One voice model per language. Select a downloaded model to activate it. Downloading requires internet access and {{cli}}.
llm.piper_restart_hint: Activating a new model requires a restart before Kåre uses it.
llm.whisper_modeldir_hint: Path to an already-converted OpenVINO IR model. Contains openvino_encoder_model.xml, openvino_decoder_model.xml, etc.
llm.whisper_compute_hint: int8 is recommended for most cases. float16/int8_float16 require a GPU. float32 works on CPU without special hardware.
llm.api_key_unset_hint: Not set — required for this provider
llm.discover_tooltip: Search for Ollama instances on the network
llm.discover_none: No Ollama found. Check that Ollama is running.
llm.img_steps_hint: Number of generation steps (e.g. 28). Higher = better quality but slower.
llm.img_guidance_hint: Text adherence (set to 1.0 for Qwen-Image-2512, otherwise 7.5).
llm.think_hint_vllm: Enables reasoning. Shown in the reasoning field from vLLM.
llm.timeout_hint: Max wait time. Empty = no limit.
llm.model_hint: Model name used by this role (stored in configs/models.yaml)
llm.gen_model_hint: Model for generating images from text (stored in configs/models.yaml)
llm.edit_model_hint: Model for editing existing images (stored in configs/models.yaml)
llm.image_provider_hint: What type of image generation service
llm.image_timeout_hint: Max wait time per image generation. Empty = no limit.
llm.agent_pool_note: Shared agent pool ({{roles}}): thinking, context and sampling are common to all these roles — a change here changes it for all of them. Only max answer length (num_predict) is per role.
llm.vllm_docker_params: vLLM Docker parameters — requires container restart to take effect
llm.reason_freely_desc: Kåre's own free-reasoning tool. Shares the vLLM instance and base URL with Kåre (main) above.
llm.ctx_locked_hint: Locked — shared with {{shared}}. Change there to adjust.
llm.role_fallback_desc: Step 2 — takes over when the main model does not answer. The cloud is only used when you ask for it («ask online»).
llm.share_with_active_note: Mechanic shares model and settings with Miss Kåre. Edit in the Miss Kåre card. Changes apply at once.
llm.frigate_borrow_hint: Main agent = Kåre's model · Sub-agents = the agent model (Miss Kåre etc.) · the borrowed model keeps its own settings.
llm.frigate_borrow_own_basic: An own model is set — turn on Expert at the top to change it.
llm.frigate_image_hint: The model that looks at the camera images when Frigate reports an event. It must understand images (text + image, VLM).
llm.frigate_conclude_image_hint: The model that decides what a whole episode meant (unusual? should someone know? one memory line) once the cameras have been quiet for a while, and at once — with the image — for not welcome, a person while you are away, or fire/smoke. Waits until nobody has talked to Kåre for a while. Shadow mode: nothing is sent. Must understand images.

num_ctx.label: Context window
num_ctx.hint: Tokens the LLM can remember (e.g. 65536). All calls to the same model MUST use identical value.

num_predict.label: Max tokens out
num_predict.hint: Max tokens in reply (e.g. 8192). Set low for fast agents.

min_p.label: Min-P
min_p.hint: Minimum token probability relative to the most likely token (e.g. 0.0).

max_model_len.label: Max context length
max_model_len.hint: max_model_len: max tokens the model can process (e.g. 32768).

gpu_memory_utilization.label: GPU memory utilization
gpu_memory_utilization.hint: gpu_memory_utilization: 0.0–1.0. 0.97 = recommended for Blackwell with FP8.

kv_cache_dtype.label: KV-cache dtype
kv_cache_dtype.hint: kv_cache_dtype: fp8 halves KV-cache size. fp16 = full precision. auto = let vLLM decide.

max_num_seqs.label: Max parallel sequences
max_num_seqs.hint: max_num_seqs: number of concurrent requests. 2 = recommended for single user (gives compact CUDA graphs).

llm.manage_section_hint: Download models and configure GPU for this instance
llm.manage_gpu_hint: Which GPU this Ollama instance runs on. Takes effect on next docker compose restart.
llm.manage_gpu_restart_note: GPU change takes effect on next docker compose restart
llm.manage_pull_hint: Copy the model name from ollama.com and paste it here
llm.manage_num_threads_hint: Number of CPU threads Ollama uses. Empty = automatic (all cores). Takes effect on docker compose restart.
llm.manage_num_parallel_hint: Concurrent requests per instance. Default: 1. Higher improves throughput but uses more VRAM.
llm.manage_max_loaded_hint: Models kept in VRAM simultaneously. Default: 1. Increase if the instance serves multiple agents with different models.
llm.manage_kv_cache_hint: f16 = full precision. q8_0 = halves KV-cache size. q4_0 = quarter, frees most VRAM.
llm.manage_flash_attn_hint: Faster inference and lower memory usage. Requires compatible GPU setup. Recommended to enable.
llm.warmup_error: Failed to load model into VRAM
llm.warmup_cpu_warning: Model running on CPU — restart the container to load into VRAM
llm.keep_warm_hint: Model stays loaded in VRAM at all times. Disable to let Ollama manage memory itself (unloads after 5 min idle).
llm.docker_control_hint: Enables container restart buttons for Ollama roles. Requires /var/run/docker.sock to be mounted.
llm.container_name_hint: The container name running this Ollama instance (e.g. ollama-agents)
llm.container_discover: Search for containers on this port
llm.container_name_required: Set container name to enable restart

inner_voices.title: Inner Voices (Jing & Jang)
inner_voices.description: Kåre's sensing and reflection layer. Jing (0.6B) scans events every 3 minutes. Jang (4B) distills them into deeper thoughts every 10 minutes.
inner_voices.model_path_hint: Local path to OpenVINO IR model. Empty = uses services/inner_voices/models/{jing|jang}/
inner_voices.node_label_hint: Shown in the dashboard under Jing/Jang status (e.g. "Local" or "NUC")
inner_voices.remote_section_hint: The remote machine pushes Jing/Jang thoughts here. Copy the token to that machine's configs/services.yaml (inner_voices.push_token).
inner_voices.push_url_hint: Empty = Jing/Jang write straight into KTSB's files (same machine or shared folder). Running on another machine: KTSB's address + /api/inner-voices/push, and the token below. Jing then also fetches who the cameras saw from KTSB (anonymous person ids, never names).
inner_voices.push_url_invalid: The push URL must start with http:// or https://.

llm.basic_mode_note: Basic mode: this model handles conversation, but tool use is unreliable. For KTSB as intended: 27B on a 24 GB+ GPU.
llm.memembed_intro2: Lets Kåre find old conversations by meaning, not just words — also when you ask in another language than the memory was written in. Pick a size: a larger model finds better matches but uses more disk and memory.
llm.memembed_note_minilm_int8: Fastest and smallest. Suits low-power machines (Raspberry Pi, mini PC).
llm.memembed_note_mpnet: Clearly better matches in Norwegian, English and German. Recommended when the machine has a few GB of free memory.
llm.memembed_note_bge_m3: Best matches. Uses the Embedding service (BGE-M3) that also serves the wiki — no separate download here, but slower per search.
llm.memembed_note_minilm: The model KTSB used before. Works, but weakest in Norwegian.
llm.memembed_needs_embedding: Turn on the «Embedding (BGE-M3)» card further up this page first.
llm.memembed_switch_warning: Memory search is rebuilt from the stored conversations. It takes from a few seconds to a few minutes, and search is weaker while it runs. No memories are deleted and the old search index is kept, so you can switch back at any time. Memories that cannot be read (encrypted without a key) are left out of the new index.
llm.memembed_download_done: Downloaded — press «Use this» to start using it.
llm.memembed_switch_skipped: {{n}} could not be read and are left out.
llm.memembed_phase_restart: Restarting the memory service with the new model …
llm.memembed_err_permission: Cannot write to the model folder. Pick another one under «Model storage» (Expert), or give KTSB write access to the folder.
llm.memembed_err_download_failed: The download failed. Check the internet connection and try again.
llm.memembed_err_service_not_ready: The memory service did not come up with the new model. The previous model has been put back.
llm.memembed_err_reindex_failed: Rebuilding memory search failed. Try «Use this» again.
llm.memembed_err_not_downloaded: The model has not been downloaded yet.
llm.memembed_err_embedding_service_off: The Embedding service (BGE-M3) is off. Turn it on first.
llm.memembed_model_dir_hint: Optional: read the model in use from another folder. Empty = the folder it was downloaded to.
llm.models_dir_hint: KTSB puts models you download from this page here (each feature gets its own sub-folder). In Docker: /kaare/models = the models/ folder next to docker-compose.yml.
llm.stt_intro_nb: Turns speech into text. For Norwegian, the National Library of Norway's NB-Whisper is used — far better on Bokmål than the standard model at every size. Runs on the CPU.
llm.stt_intro_other: Turns speech into text with OpenAI's multilingual Whisper, which is strong in English and German. Runs on the CPU.
llm.stt_note_small: Fast enough for most machines — recommended start.
llm.stt_note_medium: Better in noise, but a couple of seconds per sentence on an ordinary CPU.
llm.stt_note_large: Best, but slow on a CPU — for powerful machines.
llm.stt_custom_field_hint: Hugging Face name (org/name) or link to a CTranslate2-converted Whisper (faster-whisper). Checked before download.
llm.stt_openvino_active: In use now: the OpenVINO model «{{model}}» (Expert). Choosing a model below moves speech recognition to the CPU.
llm.stt_switch_warning: Speech recognition restarts with this model — voice control is unavailable for a few seconds.
llm.stt_switch_from_openvino: It switches from OpenVINO (iGPU) to the CPU; you can switch back under Expert → Backend.
llm.stt_download_done: Downloaded — press «Use this» to start using it.
llm.stt_switch_done: Switched — speech recognition is loading the model (large models take a moment the first time).
llm.stt_phase_check: Checking the model on Hugging Face …
llm.stt_err_not_found: That model was not found on Hugging Face.
llm.stt_err_not_ct2: The model is not a CTranslate2 conversion (no model.bin/config.json) and cannot be used by faster-whisper.
llm.stt_err_bad_repo: Enter a Hugging Face name (org/name) or a huggingface.co link.
llm.stt_err_not_downloaded: The model has not been downloaded yet.
llm.stt_err_restart_failed: The choice is saved, but speech recognition could not be restarted. Use «Restart service» (Expert).
llm.stt_err_permission: Cannot write to the model folder. Pick another under «Model storage» (Expert), or give KTSB write access.
llm.stt_err_download_failed: The download failed. Check the internet connection and try again.
llm.stt_threads_hint: Auto = half the cores (at least 2, at most 8). Measured: 4→8 threads answers 10–25 % faster; more than 8 rarely helps. Needs a service restart.
llm.media_host_hint: The address speakers on your network (ESP32, Chromecast, Home Assistant media players) fetch Kåre's audio from. Empty = detected automatically (now: {{detected}}).
llm.media_host_hint_docker: The address speakers on your network (ESP32, Chromecast, Home Assistant media players) fetch Kåre's audio from. In Docker it cannot be detected — enter the LAN address of the machine KTSB runs on.
llm.media_host_not_applied: Saved. The voice service did not answer — the address is used when it starts.

weather.title: Weather provider
weather.description: Which service Kåre uses to fetch weather data. Location is configured in the General tab. Stored in configs/settings.yaml and configs/weather.env.
weather.provider_hint: Choose weather API. met.no and Open-Meteo are free and require no key.
weather.days_hint: Number of days ahead Kåre shows (1–7). Today counts as day 1.
weather.needs_key_warning: This provider requires an API key. Without a key Kåre will return an error for weather requests.
weather.feels_like_hint: Shows feels-like temperature in addition to actual temperature (all providers).
weather.uv_hint: Shows max UV index per day (Open-Meteo only).
weather.sun_hint: Shows sunrise and sunset times per day (all providers; OWM today only).
weather.alerts_hint: Shows active weather alerts from met.no (yellow/orange/red/extreme). met.no provider only.
weather.ha_sensors_hint: Fetches current readings from outdoor sensors in Home Assistant, shown before the forecast. Find entity IDs in HA → Settings → Devices & Services.
weather.ha_temp_hint: Entity ID for outdoor temperature sensor.
weather.ha_wind_hint: Entity ID for wind speed sensor (m/s or km/h).
weather.ha_wind_gust_hint: Entity ID for wind gust sensor. Shown in parentheses after the wind speed.
weather.ha_wind_dir_hint: Entity ID for wind direction sensor. Can return a compass abbreviation (e.g. SW) or degrees (0–360).
weather.ha_precip_hint: Entity ID for current precipitation rate (mm/h).
weather.ha_precip_last_hour_hint: Entity ID for accumulated precipitation in the last hour (mm).
weather.ha_precip_today_hint: Entity ID for accumulated precipitation since midnight (mm).
weather.ha_humidity_hint: Entity ID for outdoor relative humidity sensor (%).
weather.ha_pressure_hint: Entity ID for atmospheric pressure sensor (hPa).
weather.air_quality_hint: Shows AQI and key pollution parameters (PM2.5, PM10, NO₂, O₃). Supported by: met.no (Norway only), Open-Meteo, OpenWeatherMap and WeatherAPI. Not available for PirateWeather.
weather.tides_hint: Shows high/low tides per day. Kartverket (free, Norwegian coast) or Stormglass (global, API key required).
weather.tide_provider_hint: auto = Kartverket if on Norwegian coast, otherwise Stormglass. Kartverket is always free and requires no key.
weather.stormglass_key_unset_hint: Not set — free key at stormglass.io (10 req/day). Required for tides outside Norway.
weather.owm_key_unset_hint: Not set — get a free key at openweathermap.org
weather.wapi_key_unset_hint: Not set — get a free key at weatherapi.com
weather.pirate_key_unset_hint: Not set — register for free at pirate-weather.apiable.io
weather.camera_weather_label: Use camera to see the weather
weather.camera_weather_hint: Takes a snapshot from a Frigate camera and uses AI to describe the visible weather conditions. Requires Frigate to be running and the camera pointing at the sky.
weather.camera_name_hint: Frigate API name of the camera (same name used in the camera tool, e.g. roof_camera).

websearch.title: Web search
websearch.description: Choose the search engine. SearXNG (self-hosted, no key) is the default and ships with Docker. Brave needs an API key. KTSB identifies itself honestly, obeys robots.txt and never fetches from internal addresses.
websearch.provider_hint: Primary search engine. SearXNG works without a key (Docker: http://searxng:8080).
websearch.fallback_hint: Used automatically if the primary engine fails or returns 0 hits. "None" = no fallback.
websearch.searxng_url_hint: Address of SearXNG. In Docker: http://searxng:8080 (bundled). Otherwise your own instance.
websearch.fetch_count_hint: Total number of results to request from provider
websearch.max_results_hint: Max number of URLs fetched and sent to Miss Library
websearch.content_max_hint: Number of characters fetched from each website
websearch.brave_key_unset_hint: Not set — only required if Brave is chosen as provider
websearch.hot_reload_hint: Changes apply as soon as you save.
websearch.total_timeout_hint: The whole search — engine, page fetches and summary — is stopped after this, and Kåre is told.
websearch.fetch_timeout_hint: How long one web page may take to answer.
websearch.max_bytes_hint: Larger pages are refused. Only text/HTML is read.
websearch.host_interval_label: Pause between calls to the same site (s)
websearch.host_interval_hint: Politeness: at least this long between two requests to the same website.
websearch.cache_ttl_hint: How long a fetched page is reused from memory before it is fetched again.
websearch.cache_max_hint: Number of fetched pages remembered at once (RAM only, not disk).
websearch.trusted_slots_hint: Out of «Max sources used», trusted sources get this many places first; the open web fills the rest.
websearch.official_timeout_hint: How long KTSB looks for the subject's official website (via Wikidata) before the search continues without it.
websearch.background_timeout_hint: How long a search Kåre sends off in the background may run. Kåre answers you at once and comes back with the result.

trusted.title: Whitelisted websites
trusted.description: The domains below are the household's trusted sources — they get the places first and are labelled «trusted source». Choose what kind of source each domain is and how much you trust it. Changes apply immediately.
trusted.hot_reload_hint: Changes apply as soon as you save — no hot-reload needed. Domains are stored without http://, www. and path.
trusted.open_web_hint: On: results outside the list are used too, labelled «open web» and weighted lower. Off: only the domains below are used.
trusted.blocked_hint: These domains are never used — neither in searches nor when Kåre opens a link. Saved immediately.
trusted.caution_label: How careful should Kåre be with what he finds?
trusted.caution_hint: Careful: Kåre needs more before calling something «likely», and asks you to check yourself more often. Balanced: default. Open: slightly lower bar.

law.title: Norwegian law (Lovdata)
law.description: Current Norwegian laws and central regulations from Lovdata's open datasets (NLOD 2.0). Downloaded once per night and searched locally — KTSB never fetches pages from lovdata.no, as Lovdata asks. Kåre uses it when a question is about Norwegian law.
law.enabled_hint: Switch on to download and search the laws. First download: press «Update now» (about 10 MB, a few seconds).

refleksjon.title: Kåre reflection
refleksjon.description: Kåre regularly reads Jang's distilled thoughts and considers whether something should be written in the self-image or on the notepad. The reflection runs silently in the background — no user output, no TTS. Pauses automatically during night meetings. Stored in configs/settings.yaml.
refleksjon.enabled_hint: Turn off to stop the reflection cycle entirely. Takes effect immediately.
refleksjon.interval_hint: How often Kåre checks Jang's thoughts. Minimum 1 minute. Default: 10 min.

storage.title: Image storage per user
storage.description: All images users send in and Kåre generates are stored in state/images/{user}/. Oldest images are automatically deleted when a limit is exceeded. Stored in configs/settings.yaml.
storage.count_hint: Input + output counted together. Oldest deleted when limit reached.
storage.mb_hint: Oldest images are also deleted if total size exceeds this limit.

usage.title: Usage per user
usage.description: Overview of stored image space. Updated when the page loads.

personality_mode.title: Core Personality
personality_mode.description: Choose the detail level for the core personality. Higher levels provide more context and better responses, but use more tokens.
personality_mode.minimal_desc: Name, language and 3 absolute rules only. ~80 tokens. For very resource-limited hardware.
personality_mode.letvekt_desc: Short version with core rules. Internal knowledge is tagged with [Internal knowledge – not verified]. ~150 tokens.
personality_mode.standard_desc: Full core personality with happy go lucky, three pillars and knowledge levels. ~420 tokens.
personality_mode.full_desc: Standard + behavior rules (communication style, conversation progression, tool discipline). ~650 tokens.
personality_mode.komplett_desc: Full + self-image + world. The assistant's map of its own world is always injected. Recommended. ~900 tokens.
personality_mode.egendefinert_desc: Write your own core personality. The default text is used as a starting point.
personality_mode.custom_hint: This text replaces the entire personality_core.md. personality_self.md (the assistant's self-image) is always injected in addition.
personality_mode.hot_reload_hint: The change takes effect immediately after saving (hot-reload).

selfimage.title: Kåre's self-image
selfimage.description: Kåre can write observations about itself to its self-image — knowledge that shapes who it is over time. Here you control which users can influence this through conversation. Kåre's own autonomous observations (from reflection) are always allowed, regardless of this setting. Takes effect immediately.
selfimage.name_hint: The name the assistant introduces itself with. Injected into system prompt on hot-reload.
selfimage.hotword_hint: Activation word for voice commands. Note: changing this requires retraining the voice model.
selfimage.admin_note: The 'admin' system account is not shown here.

modes.all_desc: Any conversation can contribute to the self-image, regardless of who Kåre is talking to.
modes.selected_desc: Only conversations with the users you select below can shape the self-image.
modes.admin_only_desc: The self-image is only shaped in conversations with admin users.

automationreflex.title: Kåre's self-learned automation
automationreflex.description: Kåre can propose its own automations based on habits it notices around the home (the write_reflex tool). Here you control who can approve or reject these proposals. Takes effect immediately.
automationreflex.admin_note: The 'admin' system account is not shown here.

modes.all_desc: Any user with access to the write_reflex tool can approve or reject proposals.
modes.selected_desc: Only the users you select below can approve or reject proposals.
modes.admin_only_desc: Only admin users can approve or reject proposals.

memory.title: Kåre's memory
memory.description: How Kåre's drawers (reminder list, observations, lessons, resolved topics) reach the prompt, and who can mark a topic resolved. Applies from the next message.
memory.resolve_roles_label: Who can mark a topic resolved
memory.resolve_roles_hint: When a topic is settled in a conversation, Kåre can mark it resolved. It is locked, and new observations about the same become echoes instead of new topics. Background loops can never do this.
memory.relevance_hint: Searches notes and knowledge for every message and attaches the most relevant ones in full text. Needs an embedding service: turn on the «BGE-M3 (Embeddings)» or «Semantic memory» card under Settings → LLM / Models. Without one only the index is shown.
memory.relevance_inactive: Inactive — no embedding service is on. Turn on «BGE-M3 (Embeddings)» or «Semantic memory» under Settings → LLM / Models.
memory.top_k_hint: How many notes are attached in full text (default 3).
memory.lessons_max_chars_hint: Cap for the lessons block that is always in the prompt.
memory.lessons_write_max_chars_hint: How long one lesson may be when Kåre writes it. A lesson is one rule, not a story.
memory.core_facts_max_chars_hint: Cap for the most important world facts and resolved topics shown as text; the rest is shown as an index.
memory.index_max_chars_hint: Cap for the index of the other world facts.
memory.min_score_hint: How similar a note must be to the message to be attached (0–1, default 0.50).
memory.echo_min_score_hint: How similar a new row must be to a resolved topic to count as an echo (default 0.60). Lower catches more but can hide real new faults.
memory.kare_injection_max_chars_hint: Cap for the index of Kåre's reminder list in the prompt.
memory.kare_note_prompt_chars_hint: No single note can take more than this.
memory.kare_write_max_chars_hint: Longer text is refused and Kåre is told to use observations, agenda or lessons (default 600).
memory.kare_max_entries_hint: The oldest unpinned ones are cleared when the list is full.

frigate.title: Frigate
frigate.description: Camera analysis via Frigate NVR. Stored in configs/services.yaml.
frigate.timeout_hint: Max wait time per Frigate call
frigate.snap_hint: Max wait time for image download
frigate.topic_hint: The prefix Frigate publishes events under. Default: frigate (KTSB listens on frigate/events). Takes effect after a KTSB restart.

plex.title: Plex
plex.description: Plex media server. Stored in configs/services.yaml and configs/plex.env.
plex.timeout_hint: Max wait time per Plex call
plex.token_warning: A new Plex token applies at once.
plex.status_not_configured: not set up (URL or token missing)
plex.status_connected: connected — KTSB hears from Plex the moment something plays
plex.status_token_rejected: Plex rejects the token — enter a new one
plex.status_unreachable: cannot reach the Plex server — retrying

profile.title: Distribution profile
profile.description: Choose which service bundle Kåre is installed with. Does not affect domains — those are configured separately below.
profile.hot_reload_hint: Recommended: run 'Hot-reload all config files' in the Maintenance tab after saving.

full.label: Full
full.description: All included: Jing+Jang, BGE-M3 embedding, wiki search, voice, agents.

medium.label: Medium
medium.description: Without Jing+Jang. BGE-M3 and wiki included. Voice and agents included.

letvekt.label: Lightweight
letvekt.description: Without Jing+Jang and wiki. Intent embedding only. Voice and agents included.

agenter.role_custom_placeholder: Write the role this agent should play in the meeting...
agenter.role_custom_hint: Custom text is used as the agent's instruction in the meeting system prompt.
agenter.role_hot_reload_hint: Changes take effect from the next meeting.

mechanic.label: Mechanic
mechanic.description: Technical assistant and problem solver. Used in dev meetings and for technical questions.

roles.undersøker_desc: Digs into the system using tools – fact-based and methodical. Default behaviour.
roles.kritiker_desc: Asks critical questions about Kåre's findings. No answers – only questions.
roles.analytiker_desc: Analyses patterns across meeting reports and history.
roles.egendefinert_desc: Write your own instruction for Mechanic's role in the meeting.

miss_kare.label: Miss Kåre
miss_kare.description: Evaluator – sits on the sideline and comments on the conversation. Can look up facts from Miss Library.
miss_kare.locked_personality_hint: Miss Kåre has one fixed personality, the same in chat, in the portrait night job and in the reflection meeting. It follows the language chosen for the user.

roles.empatisk_desc: Warm and caring – focus on the user's emotional life and human side. Default behaviour.
roles.analytiker_desc: Structured pattern recogniser – draws lines between observations.
roles.utfordrende_desc: Challenges assumptions about the user with open, critical questions.
roles.egendefinert_desc: Write your own instruction for Miss Kåre's role in the meeting.

miss_library.label: Miss Library
miss_library.description: Librarian and knowledge keeper. Web search is always on – local wiki requires the database to be downloaded.

tools.utforsk_desc: Read files, list directories and search code under /kaare.
tools.inspiser_desc: Read logs, check services and resources, show git diff/log.
tools.nettsøk_desc: Search the internet via the configured search provider.
tools.shell_desc: Mechanic can run read commands locally or on connected nodes — read only, never change, write or delete (chaining like ; && $( > is rejected). This is the only switch for shell. Every command is written to the audit log.
tools.hukommelse_desc: Mechanic's personal memory – persists between meetings.
tools.spør_miss_library_desc: Allow Miss Kåre to fact-check with Miss Library during evaluation.
tools.wiki_desc: Local Wikipedia database (Qdrant). Requires the wiki_no collection to be downloaded.

enforcer.label: Model guard
enforcer.description: The box between KTSB and the language model that stops promises without action, empty replies and the wrong language
enforcer.intro: Each rule (detector) checks the model's reply or tool call. «On» corrects the model with one extra round. «Shadow» only logs the hit — that is how new rules are measured before they may correct anything. «Off» does not run the rule.
enforcer.save_hint: Changes apply from the next message — no restart.

tool_promise.label: Promise without tool
tool_promise.desc: Kåre says he noted something, set a timer, put something on the agenda etc. without calling the tool.

claimed_done.label: Claims it is done
claimed_done.desc: The reply says something was written or saved, but no tool ran in the request.

truncated_think.label: Cut-off thinking
truncated_think.desc: The model used up its space on thinking and gave no answer.

language_mismatch.label: Wrong language
language_mismatch.desc: The reply is in another language than the one the user chose.

foreign_script.label: Foreign script
foreign_script.desc: The reply contains characters from another writing system (e.g. Chinese).

near_home_missing.label: Web search without home choice
near_home_missing.desc: A web search lacks the choice whether the home place applies — the call is sent back before it runs.

stakes_missing.label: Web search without stakes
stakes_missing.desc: A web search lacks how much is at stake — the call is sent back before it runs.

cut_or_invalid_output.label: Cut-off / invalid answer
cut_or_invalid_output.desc: The answer was cut off or could not be read (Miss Library, the Frigate user).

frigate_lang_tag.label: Language tag in camera answer
frigate_lang_tag.desc: The Frigate user's JSON answer contained a [LANG:xx] tag that does not belong there.

frigate_state_carried.label: Person copied forward
frigate_state_carried.desc: The vision model said a known person is still in the image, but Frigate tracks no person there and the model reported nothing new about them. Code sets the person as gone.

frigate_unsupported_change.label: New person without support
frigate_unsupported_change.desc: The vision model reported a new person where Frigate tracks no person. Code leaves the person out.

frigate_missed_change.label: Missed change
frigate_missed_change.desc: Frigate saw a person arrive or leave since the previous frame from the same camera, but the answer has no change in who is in the image.

frigate_wrong_language.label: Wrong language in camera answer
frigate_wrong_language.desc: The texts in the vision model's answer are in another language than the household's (code guesses the language).

frigate_thin_scene.label: Empty camera scene
frigate_thin_scene.desc: The vision model's scene field said almost nothing (e.g. only «night»). Code then writes what was not there, from the model's other fields.

frigate_empty_output.label: Empty camera answer
frigate_empty_output.desc: The model answered nothing (or only a language tag) to a camera image.

ungrounded_quote.label: Quote not in sources
ungrounded_quote.desc: Miss Library quoted something that is not in the sources.

unsupported_claim.label: Claim without source
unsupported_claim.desc: Miss Library claimed something with no quote to support it.

irrelevant_quote.label: Quote misses the question
irrelevant_quote.desc: Miss Library quoted something off-topic while the sources hold something on-topic.

tool_call_as_text.label: Tool call written as text
tool_call_as_text.desc: The model wrote a tool call out as text instead of making the call.

ungrounded_path.label: File not in the sources
ungrounded_path.desc: The answer names files or paths that no tool result or task contains — an invented finding.

ungrounded_object.label: Stores something that does not exist
ungrounded_object.desc: A saving tool would store an HA entity, a KTSB node or a file that neither the house's register nor anything in the conversation shows — checked before the call runs.

action_claim.label: Claimed action without a call
action_claim.desc: Kåre says he switched on a light, set a timer, asked Mechanic, marked something resolved etc., but no such action with the tool ran.

visual_claim_no_image.label: Sees without an image
visual_claim_no_image.desc: The answer says Kåre sees something while code knows no image reached him in this turn (neither the user's own nor one from an image tool). Shadow: counts hits, changes nothing, never stores the answer's text.

repeated_theme.label: Repeated meeting theme
repeated_theme.desc: Night meeting: a theme raised for the third night (code counts; a separate short model call says whether it repeats an earlier night) is refused and becomes one question to the user. Shadow until a measurement shows it is right.

frigate_unsupported_sense.label: Fire, weather or sound without support
frigate_unsupported_sense.desc: A camera episode's conclusion mentions fire, smoke, weather, sound or smell that nothing the model was given (events, scene, code's facts, Frigate's labels) supports. Shadow: counts hits. On: the model gets one more round, without the word being named.

diskbruk.argus_description: Argus makes the logs searchable for Kåre. Nothing is deleted for being old: when the limit is reached, the oldest days go first. Before a day is deleted, a short summary of it is kept for good — event counts per source and entity, and every warning and error verbatim.
diskbruk.limit_hint: 0 = off (no limit). Default {{def}} MB. Checked every night in the night sequence; today's events are never deleted.
diskbruk.argus_off: Off — Argus grows without a limit.
diskbruk.argus_warn_below_usage: The limit is below what Argus uses now — the oldest days are summarised and deleted next night.
diskbruk.measured_estimate: The size is estimated from the number of events.
diskbruk.unavailable: Could not reach Qdrant — the size cannot be measured right now.
diskbruk.rolled_days: Summarised and deleted: {{n}} days ({{first}} – {{last}}). The summaries are kept for good.

status.max_days_reached: maximum days per night reached, continues next night
status.error: stopped on an error, nothing more deleted

diskbruk.overview_description: Everything KTSB stores that grows by itself. Nothing is deleted for being old: when a limit is reached, the oldest goes first.
diskbruk.disk_line: KTSB is set up to use {{limits}} GB of {{total}} GB on {{mount}} ({{free}} GB free now).
diskbruk.disk_unlimited: {{n}} data types on this disk have no limit yet — they get one in the next step.
diskbruk.over_commit: The limits on this disk add up to more than the disk can give. Lower a limit or free some space.
diskbruk.group_hint: Changing a group's limit here scales its data types by the same factor (proportionally). Limits with their own place in the GUI (Frigate, Images) are set there. Single limits are set in Expert.
diskbruk.group_partly: {{n}} of the data types in this group have no limit yet.
diskbruk.classes_description: Each data type on its own. 0 = off (no limit).
diskbruk.argus_floor: KTSB keeps {{mb}} MB because that much existed when the limit arrived. Save a limit to use it as written.

home.frigate: Set in Integrations → Frigate → Storage limits (Expert).
home.images: Set in the image cards further down (per user).

master.title: KTSB's screen page
master.description: Live camera and cards (e.g. recipes) on TVs, Nest Hubs and browsers. Off = no screen page, and Kåre does not see these actions.

live.title: Live camera
live.description: How long a live camera stays on a screen before it stops by itself. The screen then goes back to how it was.
live.minutes_hint: Kåre can set another time when you ask («show the doorbell for ten minutes»).

rtsp.title: Frigate RTSP port
rtsp.description: The port Frigate sends the camera streams on (go2rtc, default 8554). Used when KTSB has to re-encode a stream.

bruker.title: Create first user
bruker.description: Add at least one user besides admin. You can also skip and do this later.

integrasjoner.title: Integrations
integrasjoner.description: Kåre works without all of these. Fill in what you have — or skip and configure via the Integrations page later.
integrasjoner.ha_token_hint: Create it in Home Assistant: your profile → Security → Long-lived access tokens. With URL and token, Home Assistant is turned on.
integrasjoner.subnet_hint: Suggested from where you are connecting. Devices here count as «home». Empty = every 192.168.x.x network. Change it later in Settings → General → Network and access (Expert).
integrasjoner.media_host_hint: Only for speakers on your network (ESP32, Chromecast, Home Assistant). Suggested: the address you opened KTSB on. Change it under Settings → LLM → Piper.

ferdig.description: Basic setup complete. You can configure more via the Admin panel at any time.
hints: Add aliases for Norwegian HA entity names (Aliases in menu)

llm.title: LLM source
llm.description: Kåre needs access to a language model (LLM). Choose whether to use the built-in one or one you already have.
llm.builtin_hint: Recommended for beginners. Simple setup, everything included.
llm.builtin_warning: Downloads approx. 10 GB on first startup.
llm.builtin_note_body: The default .env.example has this configured. Run setup.sh to confirm the setup, then docker compose up -d.
llm.external_hint: You have Ollama, vLLM or a cloud API running elsewhere.
llm.external_url_hint: Compatible with Ollama and OpenAI API (vLLM, LM Studio, etc.)

hot_reload.title: Hot-reload config
hot_reload.description: Reloads YAML files in running processes — without restart. Covers: aliases, lang_normalize, capability_map, llm.yaml, models.yaml, services.yaml, settings.yaml, personality.
hot_reload.note: Note: API keys (Brave/NVIDIA) and ha-log-bridge remain cached in RAM after hot-reload — these need service restart below. MQTT reconnects by itself when its settings are saved.

health_check.title: System check
health_check.description: Checks imports, config files and that all services respond.

test_run.title: Test run
test_run.description: Runs automated tests against system logs and code.

services.description: Restart one service after config changes not caught by hot-reload. Green dot = service is running.
services.not_created: Not started (outside the selected distribution profile)
services.unavailable: Restart control not available in this setup

kaare.hint: Port 8000. Restart for new LLM settings and config.

agents.hint: Runs in-process in kaare.service. Restart after LLM change for these roles.

rollback.confirm: This resets ALL config files to factory defaults. All custom settings, models and service URLs will be lost. Continue?
rollback.pin_warning: ⚠️ This resets all settings to factory defaults — as if freshly installed. All custom values will be lost. Recovery points are kept.

backup.title: Full backup
backup.description: Download a ZIP with all user data. Can be restored here after a fresh install or data loss.
backup.cat_ltm_database: Long-term memory (conversations, episodes, Kåre's drawers, Frigate memory, watch history)
backup.cat_argus_events: Argus log (system events — can be large)
backup.cat_user_profiles: User profiles (observations, per-user data, conversation archive)
backup.cat_notes_state: Notes and state (notepad, timers, lists, meeting topics, home mode, security corrections)
backup.cat_secrets: Secrets (API keys, tokens and VPN client keys)
backup.cat_images: Images (generated, uploaded and kept Frigate episode frames — can be large)

The system key is never part of a backup: if you restore onto a new machine, each user has to log in with their PIN once before the background jobs (reflection, night job) can reach their data again.

backup.restore_point_warning: This will overwrite current data with backup point "{{name}}". Confirm with PIN. github.title: GitHub publishing
github.description: Kåre will be published on GitHub. Never hardcode usernames, place names, Home Assistant URL, API keys or timezone directly in code. All such values are stored in configs/settings.yaml or .env files that are not checked in.

hardware.title: Hardware
hardware.description: Detected CPU, RAM, GPU and NPU. Run setup.sh on the host for full detection.
hardware.note_gpu: GPU detected — enable by adding COMPOSE_FILE=docker-compose.yml:docker-compose.gpu.yml to .env and running setup.sh

master.description: Enable or disable the entire notification system

normalcy.title: Normalcy thresholds
normalcy.description: Thresholds for the event feed on the Security page

update.title: Update KTSB
update.description: Install a newer KTSB version from GitHub. A backup point is saved automatically first; if something does not start properly, the previous version is put back on its own.
update.not_docker: Updating from the GUI is for Docker installs. This install runs directly on the machine and is updated outside the GUI.
update.unreachable: The update service (kaare-updater) is not answering. Run «docker compose up -d» once in the install folder to start it.
update.check_failed: Could not reach GitHub. Check the internet connection and try again.
update.confirm_text: KTSB saves a backup point, downloads the new version and restarts all services. Kåre is unavailable for a few minutes. If something goes wrong, the previous version is put back automatically. Enter your PIN to continue.
update.restarting: KTSB is restarting — this page reconnects by itself.
update.rolled_back: The update failed, and KTSB has been put back to {{version}}.
update.failed: The update did not go ahead. Nothing was changed.
update.rollback_failed: The update failed, and the previous version could not be started either. See logs/updater.log, or run «docker compose up -d» in the install folder.
update.data_hint: Your data was not touched. The backup point from before the update is in the list below if you also want to restore it.
update.rollback_confirm_title: Go back to the previous version?
update.rollback_confirm_text: KTSB restarts on {{version}}. Your data stays as it is now. Enter your PIN to continue.
update.err_night_sequence_running: The night sequence is running. Try again when it has finished.
update.err_no_home: This install folder is not set up for updates from the GUI. Run setup.sh (Linux/macOS) or setup.ps1 (Windows) once in the install folder, then «docker compose up -d».
update.err_no_compose: The update service cannot find the install folder. Run setup.sh / setup.ps1 once more, then «docker compose up -d».
update.err_no_docker_socket: The update service has no access to Docker.
update.err_save_point_failed: Could not save the backup point before the update. Nothing was changed.
update.err_updater_unreachable: The update service is not answering.
update.err_nothing_to_roll_back_to: There is no previous version to go back to.

phase.preflight: Checking that the update can run
phase.swap: Keeping the current files and putting the new ones in place
phase.verify_images: Checking that every image was signed by KTSB
phase.start: Starting KTSB on the new version

update.test_versions_hint: Also shows test versions (rc) in «Update KTSB» — before a regular release comes out. They are signed and checked like regular releases, but less tested. Off by default. Applies from the next «Check for updates».

login.title: Kåre
login.subtitle: Log in to continue
login.reauth_subtitle: Service was restarted. Enter your PIN to restore your history.
login.choose_pin_sub: Hi, {{name}}! You need to set a personal PIN before you continue.
login.error_pin_short: PIN must be at least 6 digits.

users.frigate_desc_on: Yes: when Frigate recognises the face, KTSB learns the name (as today).
users.frigate_desc_off: No: KTSB removes the name when the event comes in. The event is kept, but as an anonymous «person».
users.frigate_scope: Applies to KTSB only. Frigate's own face library and history, and Home Assistant's Frigate integration, are not changed. What KTSB has already stored is not rewritten.
users.frigate_no_faces: No Frigate faces are linked to this person yet, so the choice has no effect until an admin links them (Users → edit).
users.frigate_decided_admin: No guardian is set up, so an admin decides this.
users.frigate_faces_desc: The names in Frigate's face library that are this person. One face belongs to one person.
users.frigate_faces_free_text: No faces found in Frigate (not set up, or face recognition is off). Type the name as it appears in Frigate.
users.frigate_faces_unreachable: Cannot reach Frigate. Type the name as it appears in Frigate.
users.title: Users

edit.title: Edit — {{name}}
edit.vpn_ai_only: AI only — AI chat externally, not smart home
edit.can_manage_child_timers_desc: Can set timers for children and teens
edit.is_parent_desc: Can view and comment on children's profiles and reflections
edit.pin_required_desc: No remember-me — PIN required on every login
edit.plex_account_desc: The account this person watches Plex with. KTSB then knows what they watched, where, and what comes next. One account per person — a shared account cannot tell who watched.

delete_modal.title: Delete user
delete_modal.confirm: Are you sure you want to delete {{name}}? This cannot be undone.

vpn_modal.scan_hint: Scan with WireGuard app — shown only now.

tools.title: Tool permissions per role
tools.description: Control which tools Kåre can use per user role. Changes take effect immediately.
tools.always_included: Self-image, world and user profile are always included for regular users (locked ✓). For Household and Stranger they are off by default and can be switched on here.
tools.admin_only: Inner thoughts and thought history can contain other users' conversations and are for the administrator only (—).
tools.camera_note: Camera — see: pictures, episodes, search and who/what/where that is already stored. New analysis: Kåre starts the image model again (uses the graphics card). On top of that Kåre always has a short overview of what the cameras saw in the last 30 minutes, for everyone in the household. Names are only included for people who have not switched off «Frigate may track me» (Settings). Guests and unknown voices never get names.

global_user.name: Household (unrecognised voice)
global_user.desc: A person inside the house who isn't recognised — most likely a household member. Gets what the house shares, but no individual's own data.

unknown_user.name: Unknown person
unknown_user.desc: A person we don't trust, e.g. at an outdoor or door node. Learns nothing about the house or the people there.

system.no_actions: System user: cannot log in or be deleted. Its tools are set in the table below.
system.admin_note: Built-in administrator — only the PIN can be changed.

users.frigate_looks_desc_on: Yes: the image model describes facial expressions and gestures (for example whether the person smiles or waves) in episodes this person is part of.
users.frigate_looks_desc_off: No: in an episode where KTSB recognises this person, KTSB asks nobody's expression or gesture. What is already stored is not rewritten.

user.error_pin_short: PIN must be at least 6 digits.

aliases.title: Rooms and aliases
aliases.description: Where things are in the house, and which names Kåre should recognise for them. With Home Assistant connected the rooms come from there. Changes take effect immediately.
aliases.hot_reload_note: Changes take effect immediately (hot-reload) — no restart required.
aliases.grouping_note: The room comes from Home Assistant for HA devices, otherwise from the place you chose under Rooms.
aliases.dlg_key_hint: What you say or type to Kåre, e.g. «living room light».
aliases.dlg_entity_hint: Pick a known device or type the HA ID (domain.name).
aliases.dlg_room_hint: For things outside Home Assistant, or that HA has not placed.
aliases.dlg_room_name_hint: Saved in lower case with _ instead of spaces.
aliases.dlg_err_key_taken: This text is already used by another alias.
aliases.dlg_err_entity: Entity ID must look like domain.name, e.g. light.living_room_ceiling.
aliases.dlg_err_room_empty: Give the new room a name.
aliases.dlg_err_room_taken: A room with this name already exists — pick it in the list.
aliases.dlg_room_from_ha: The room comes from Home Assistant. Move the device in HA if it is wrong.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: The services KTSB connects to: Home Assistant, MQTT, Frigate and Plex. All are optional — KTSB works without them.

frigate_user.title: Frigate user (shadow mode)
frigate_user.description: KTSB's eyes. Checks the name Frigate gives a face against the image itself and remembers what the cameras saw. In shadow mode no alerts are sent and nothing Kåre says changes yet.
frigate_user.state_on: On: every Frigate event is checked and stored next to the usual analysis.
frigate_user.state_off: Off: nothing is checked or stored.
frigate_user.episode_gap_s_hint: An event that starts within this long after the last activity belongs to the same situation. 10–3600.
frigate_user.episode_min_movement_label: Minimum movement for vehicles (share of the image)
frigate_user.episode_min_movement_hint: A car, or anything Frigate reports as stationary, keeps a situation open only when it moves at least this much of the image. This stops a parked car from keeping a situation open for hours. 0.01–1.
frigate_user.visit_gap_s_hint: The same person seen again within this long counts as one visit. 60–86400.
frigate_user.visit_fold_interval_s_hint: How often events are grouped into visits. 30–3600.
frigate_user.l0_min_face_px_hint: Smaller faces are too small to check: the name is stored as "Frigate's claim, unverified" without asking a model.
frigate_user.l0_min_claim_score_hint: A lower score from Frigate's face recognition counts as too uncertain to check. 0 = only Frigate's own threshold.
frigate_user.conclude_idle_gate_s_label: Wait until nobody has talked to Kåre for (seconds)
frigate_user.conclude_idle_gate_s_hint: The summary uses Kåre's model; it waits so it does not slow down conversations. 0–3600.
frigate_user.conclude_max_attempts_hint: How many times a summary is retried before it is given up. 1–10.
frigate_user.retention_dry_run_hint: The night job builds the hourly and daily summaries but deletes and slims nothing — it only logs what it would do. Turn off when the numbers look right.
frigate_user.retention_keep_unknown_plates_hint: Plates Frigate does not know. Choose «Always» only if the plate camera sees your own driveway, not the road. Known plates are always kept. Privacy rule: the text is removed after the time, but a confirmed plate keeps its anonymous vehicle id (never the plate number), so KTSB can recognise a rare visitor.
frigate_user.retention_footer: Situations, visits and daily counts are always kept. The size limit for camera events is set in Storage limits at the bottom of this tab. Names of unclassified faces are removed after the days set under Face classification.
frigate_user.episode_weather_hint: The weather around the episode (precipitation, wind, cloud cover) is attached to the route, the false-detection line and the conclusion. The source is what you chose in Settings → Weather: its HA sensors when they are on, else the weather service (met.no or open-meteo). The vision model does not get the weather, so it is not led by it.
frigate_user.conclude_analyse_per_10min_hint: How many times the «Analyse» / «Analyse again» button in the episode view can be started per 10 minutes, for the whole household. Each run is one vision model call and one main model call. Default 2.
frigate_user.conclude_stuck_after_min_hint: When an episode is still open, or still has no conclusion, this many minutes after its last activity, the episode view shows «stuck» with what KTSB knows about why, and the «Analyse again» button.
frigate_user.expressions_hint: The image model describes facial expressions and gestures per frame, in its own words, when the person is large enough in the image. Each person can turn it off for themselves (children and teens: their guardians) under «Frigate may track me»; then nothing is asked in episodes where that person is recognised.
frigate_user.questions_chat_hint: Kåre may now and then put one question from the user's own list («Was it you?», night-meeting themes) at the end of a chat answer — never in voice, never after a command, at most a few a day; if the user says no or leaves it, he asks less often.
frigate_user.questions_wrong_rules_hint: When admin answered «not a …» or «wrong detection» under «What is this?», KTSB holds that detection back at exactly that spot on that camera — only when it stands still and no other camera sees the same. Off (default): KTSB only writes on the event that it would have held it back (shadow).

frigate_faces.title: Face classification
frigate_faces.description: The faces Frigate has learned. Choose what each person is to the house: household, safe guest or not welcome. Frigate does not know this itself — it is your decision. Faces Frigate does not know are always «unknown».
frigate_faces.unclassified_banner: Faces not classified: {{count}}. Until they are classified they count as unknown, and the name Frigate gives them is kept for only {{days}} days.
frigate_faces.empty: Frigate has no faces in its face library yet. Train faces in Frigate (Face Library) and they show up here.
frigate_faces.error_not_configured: Frigate is not set up — enter its address in the connection card above.
frigate_faces.error_unreachable: Cannot reach Frigate. Showing only the faces already classified.
frigate_faces.claim_note: Frigate recognises faces but can be wrong. KTSB treats the name Frigate gives as a claim and checks it against the image and the profile above before the name is stored or used in an alert.
frigate_faces.days_label: Keep the name of unclassified faces for (days)
frigate_faces.days_hint: 0–90. After this an unclassified face is stored only as «person».

frigate_episodes.title: Episodes
frigate_episodes.description: What the cameras saw, grouped per situation across cameras. The Frigate user is in shadow mode: nothing is sent, and names are Frigate's claim with KTSB's check — not fact.
frigate_episodes.empty: No episodes yet — the Frigate user is in shadow mode and collects them as the cameras see something.
frigate_episodes.empty_off: No episodes — the Frigate user is switched off. Turn it on with the switch in the «Frigate user» card further down under Integrations → Frigate.
frigate_episodes.no_frames_vehicles: No images — vehicles only, concluded by code without the image model.
frigate_episodes.scene_skipped: Vehicles only — the image model was not asked.
frigate_episodes.scene_skipped_look: The image model answered the closed question and saw no person or animal — the description was not run.
frigate_episodes.scene_failed: The image model did not answer ({{reason}}).
frigate_episodes.conclusion_open: The episode is ongoing — the conclusion comes once it has been quiet for a while.
frigate_episodes.conclusion_pending: Awaiting conclusion (runs when nobody is using Kåre).
frigate_episodes.suppressed: The model said «unusual», but the cameras' baseline is too thin ({{days}} days) — turned off by code: {{reason}}
frigate_episodes.storage_frames_hint: the frames the model saw · over the cap older episodes keep one frame · 0 = not stored
frigate_episodes.storage_keep_hint: kept long · over the cap the oldest go
frigate_episodes.store_cannot_write: The camera memory cannot write: {{cause}} ({{count}} failed writes). New events are lost to KTSB until this is fixed.
frigate_episodes.store_cause_read_only: the database is read-only – check owner and permissions of frigate.db and its -wal/-shm files
frigate_episodes.store_cause_permission: permission denied – check owner and permissions of the state/frigate folder
frigate_episodes.store_cause_locked: the database is locked by another writer
frigate_episodes.store_cause_cannot_open: the database file cannot be opened
frigate_episodes.scene_waiting: Waiting for analysis — the vision model could not be reached. The frames are kept; KTSB tries again by itself.
frigate_episodes.conclusion_waiting: Waiting for analysis — no conclusion before the frames are checked.
frigate_episodes.not_checked: Not checked with images — the conclusion rests only on Frigate's reports and the route.
frigate_episodes.stuck_not_closed: Stuck: the episode is not closed {{minutes}} min after its last activity. «Analyse again» closes it and analyses.
frigate_episodes.stuck_queued: Stuck: no conclusion {{minutes}} min after the last activity — queued for analysis, not started.
frigate_episodes.stuck_waiting: Stuck: no conclusion {{minutes}} min after the last activity — the image model did not answer ({{attempts}} tries), next try {{next}}.
frigate_episodes.stuck_failed: Stuck: the conclusion failed {{attempts}} time(s), no conclusion {{minutes}} min after the last activity.
frigate_episodes.stuck_running: Stuck: analysis started {{started}}, not finished ({{minutes}} min after the last activity).
frigate_episodes.analyse_err_analysis_running: An analysis is already running — wait for it to finish.
frigate_episodes.analyse_err_analysis_rate_limited: Too many analyses in a short time — try again in a few minutes.
frigate_episodes.analyse_err_switch_off: The Frigate user is switched off (Integrations → Frigate).
frigate_episodes.analyse_err_episode_open: The episode is still going on.
frigate_episodes.analyse_err_no_frames: No frames to analyse — they are neither stored nor in Frigate's recordings any more.
frigate_episodes.analyse_err_model_unreachable: The vision model does not answer — nothing was changed. Try again later.
frigate_episodes.story_timeline_note: Times, cameras and «nobody in the image» are code; the place and what a person carries are the image model's own words and may be in English.
frigate_episodes.story_changes_note: Code compares frames before and after the episode. It says where, not what.
frigate_episodes.sensor_not_face: not a face (the box was torso-sized)
frigate_episodes.story_after_frames: Frame after the episode (shown here only; no model sees it):
frigate_episodes.storage_db_hint: text and counts · over the limit the oldest details go first · daily counts are kept · 0 = no limit

face_votes.title: Extra face recognition
face_votes.description: A second, independent face recognition (e.g. Double Take) gives its own vote on who Frigate saw. The vote is a claim, never a fact: when both agree it becomes «very likely», when they disagree it becomes «uncertain» and goes on the review list. KTSB only listens — it sends nothing there.
face_votes.needs_frigate_user: Works only while the Frigate user (shadow mode) above is on.
face_votes.restart_hint: Changes take effect within half a minute — no restart.
face_votes.provider_hint: Which face recognition the votes come from.
face_votes.topic_hint: The prefix the provider publishes under (Double Take: mqtt.topics). Default: double-take — KTSB listens on double-take/matches/#, double-take/cameras/+ and double-take/available.
face_votes.rest_hint: Optional. Used by the test button and to read each detector's own answer (read only, GET), e.g. http://192.168.0.x:3000. Without it KTSB only sees what Double Take sends on MQTT, where two detectors saying the same name are merged into one.
face_votes.min_hint: 0 = the provider's own «match» flag. Double Take says «match» from its own threshold (detect.match.confidence) — set a higher value here if the votes are too unsure.
face_votes.rest_read_fail: Could not read Double Take's per-detector answers ({{error}}) — using MQTT only.

face_sensors.title: Face sensors
face_sensors.description: Each face recognition gives its own vote: Frigate's own and each detector in Double Take. Here you decide how much each one is worth alone. On Auto, KTSB is to learn it over time.
face_sensors.question: When this sensor alone says a name, it is …
face_sensors.label: Display name
face_sensors.auto_now: what is learned is used after ~{{n}} answers; counts as «{{word}}» against the others for now
face_sensors.counts: voted on {{votes}} events · agreed with the others {{agree}} · disagreed {{disagree}}
face_sensors.no_detectors: No Double Take detectors seen yet. They appear once Double Take has answered on a person.
face_sensors.verified_note: «Verified» comes only from a person answering yes to «Was it you?» — never from a sensor.
face_sensors.learn_all: Auto uses what KTSB has learned
face_sensors.learn_all_hint: Once a sensor has about {{n}} answers to «Was it you?» (on the same camera), Auto uses the word the answers give instead of «uncertain». A fixed word you choose always wins. Off = Auto stays «uncertain» for all.
face_sensors.learn_one: Use what was learned for this sensor
face_sensors.auto_acting: what was learned is used now: counts as «{{word}}»

frigate_modules.intro: The camera pipe as modules. Modules 2, 4, 5 and 6 can be switched here; 3 follows the Frigate user; 0 and 7 are always on. 4–6 are off by default.
frigate_modules.error: Could not read or save the modules.
frigate_modules.warn_double_work: Modules 1 and 4 are both on: still image per event and frame by frame do nearly the same job (double work). This is allowed.

frigate_modules.why_auto_double_take_off: auto: Double Take is not set up
frigate_modules.why_not_set_up: on here, but not set up (see its settings)
frigate_modules.m1_replaced: Replaced by L3 per event and module 4 (frame by frame) — see «Latest detections».
frigate_modules.heavy_hint: Uses the main model — on a small machine it is the same model Kåre answers with, so answers can get slower while the cameras work.

reflections.settings_dev_slot_desc: The dev slot runs every night right after the reflection meeting. Kåre cleans up his agenda, investigates problems with read-only tools, and only findings backed by the sources count as verified. The slot never changes anything itself.
reflections.night_desc: Once every night Kåre tidies his memory, fetches new law text from Lovdata (if switched on), writes user portraits, reviews his knowledge and holds the reflection meeting and the dev slot — in that order. Choose when it starts.
reflections.night_start_hint: Time of day in the household timezone ({{tz}}). Applies from the next night, no restart needed. If the machine is off at the start time, the night still runs if KTSB is back up within 6 hours.

Thinking counts: the turn itself is short (about 100–600), the rest is thinking. Below about 3000 often gives empty replies. Recommended 6000–8192 (default 8192). Higher works, but a turn that loops then takes longer.
reflections.settings_miss_kare_tokens_hint: Same as «Max tokens out» in the LLM tab, but only for Miss Kåre's turns. Without thinking (default) her replies are about 100–250 tokens, so 1000–1500 gives good margin (default 1500). Below about 300 a reply can be cut mid-sentence. If you turn thinking on for her, use the same values as for Kåre.
